query_plan.query: How many airports are above 3000 meters elevation?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by airport id, count the amount.
steps.query: Return all airports above 3000 meters elevation, with their airport id and airport name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM airports WHERE elevation_m > 3000

s1.sql_query: SELECT airports.airport, airports.name, airports.elevation_m FROM airports WHERE airports.elevation_m > 3000
